game.name: Bishoujo Senshi Sailor Moon S - Fuwa Fuwa Panic 2
game.desc: Bishoujo Senshi Sailor Moon Súper S: Fuwa Fuwa Panic es un juego de puzles competitivo con temática de Sailor Moon. Los jugadores primero seleccionan un personaje de entre las cinco Sailor y Chibiusa, cada uno con un movimiento especial único. Luego se desafiarán unos a otros. Cada jugador tiene una tabla que contiene globos, ya sea rojos, amarillos, verdes o azules. Estos globos se pueden disparar para ganar puntos y llenar la barra de poder. Los globos del mismo color que están adyacentes entre sí serán destruidos y generarán más puntos. El objetivo es evitar ser el jugador cuyos globos son empujados hacia abajo desde el tablero, y hacer que el oponente reciba este destino. A medida que se destruyen grupos de globos, se revelar potenciadores y aparecen globos negros en el tablero del oponente. Los globos negros solo pueden ser destruidos por grupos de globos de colores que se eliminan junto a ellos. Los jugadores con una barra de poder llena pueden desatar habilidades especiales.

game.name: Crayon Shin-chan - Nagagutsu Dobon!!
game.desc: Juego de acción. Está basado en el anime Lápiz Shin-Chan. El objetivo del juego es salpicar los charcos y empapar a los oponentes. Los charcos tienen sus especificidades según su tamaño. Aprovechar su disposición es la clave para mojar a los oponentes. También hay bonos que el jugador puede recoger durante el juego.

game.name: Gegege No Kitarou - Youkai Donjara
game.desc: Gegege no Kitarou: Youkai Donjaara es una compilación de rompecabezas y juegos de mesa basados en el anime de horror infantil Gege no Kitarou . Sigue centrándose en el juego del donjaara, una versión simplificada del mahjong infantil, pero también incluye varios minijuegos.

game.name: Gekisou Sentai Car Rangers
game.desc: En este juego, el jugador se mueve a través de los niveles luchando contra enemigos menores antes de chocar con un jefe. A lo largo del nivel, el jugador puede obtener bonos y recoger "monedas" de la destrucción de vehículos y otros objetos del entorno.

game.name: Poi Poi Ninja World
game.desc: Poi Pio Ninja World es un juego multijugador de tipo Bomberman en el que los jugadores intentan enfrentarse a sus oponentes colocando bombas, rocas y otros objetos. El juego podría vincularse con otros cartuchos de Poi Poi Ninja World, insertados en la segunda ranura del Sufami Turbo, lo que permitiría el intercambio de varias copias de seguridad de datos.

game.name: Axis Senki
game.desc: SD Gundam Generation: Axis Senki , also called SD Gundam Generation C, is a strategy video game developed and published by Bandai in August 1996 for Super Nintendo. It is a video game adaptation of the series based on the anime Mobile Suit Gundam and especially Super Deformed Gundam. It is the third opus of a series of six video games called SD Gundam Generation.

game.name: Babylonia Kenkoku Senki
game.desc: It is a video game adaptation of the series based on the anime Mobile Suit Gundam and especially Super Deformed Gundam. It is the fourth opus of a series of six video games called SD Gundam Generation

game.name: Colony Kakutouki
game.desc: It is a video game adaptation of the anime series Mobile Suit Gundam and specifically Super Deformed Gundam. It is the latest installment in a series of six video games called SD Gundam Generation 1.

game.name: Gryps Senki
game.desc: It is the second of six SD Gundam Generation games released for the Sufami Turbo peripheral, which uses smaller carts that can communicate with each other when inserted into the Sufami Turbo device.

game.name: Ichinen Sensouki
game.desc: It is a video game adaptation of the series based on the Mobile Suit Gundam anime, specifically Super Deformed Gundam. This is the first in a series of six video games called SD Gundam Generation1,2.

game.name: Zanscare Senki
game.desc: SD Gundam Generation: Zanscare Senki ("Record of Zanscare War") is a licensed strategy game for the Super Famicom. It draws its conflicts and characters from the Mobile Suit Victory Gundam series. It is the fifth of six SD Gundam Generation games released for the Sufami Turbo peripheral, which uses smaller carts that can communicate with each other when inserted into the Sufami Turbo device.

game.name: Seven Densetsu
game.desc: SD Ultra Battle: Seven Densetsu ("SD Ultra Battle: Seven Legend") is a fighter game for the Super Famicom that features super deformed characters from the Ultra Seven series, itself a follow-up to the original Ultraman tokusatsu show. Along with series protagonist Ultraseven, the game also features major kaiju villains Eleking and King Joe as playable characters. The game was a companion product to SD Ultra Battle: Ultraman Densetsu, and was released the same day. Both carts employ Bandai's officially licensed Nintendo peripheral the Sufami Turbo to link together to share game data, allowing characters from one game to appear and fight characters in the other. Because Seven Densetsu was released in the miniature Sufami Turbo cartridge format, it cannot be played without that peripheral.

game.name: Ultraman Densetsu
game.desc: SD Ultra Battle: Ultraman Densetsu ("SD Ultra Battle: Ultraman Legend") is a fighter game for the Super Famicom that features super deformed characters from the Ultraman series. Along with series protagonist Ultraman, the game also features two of his most memorable opponents Alien Baltan and the Red King. The game was a companion product to SD Ultra Battle: Seven Densetsu, and was released the same day. Both carts employ Bandai's officially licensed Nintendo peripheral the Sufami Turbo to link together to share game data, allowing characters from one game to appear and fight characters in the other. Because Ultraman Densetsu was released in the miniature Sufami Turbo cartridge format, it cannot be played without that peripheral. One version of Ultraman Densetsu included the Sufami Turbo peripheral as a pack-in bundle.
